title: Q-BLIND-domain-renewal: close the continuity blind spot domain-renewal
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every blindspots scan
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation blindspots --closed domain-renewal
**Prediction:** blindspots_open <= 7 within 168 h
**Status:** closed

Why the owner would not know to ask: A lapsed domain takes the site, email and every registry listing with it.
Action: read RDAP expiry on a clock and file a money gate 60 days out. The probe in doctrine/blindspots.json passes when it is done.

**Evidence:** closing probe passed (6 consecutive passes after a recorded failure): domain-renewal: ok
